title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy , policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Engenheiro de Certificação, você irá:

  • Responsável pela homologação de novos produtos SANY no mercado brasileiro;
  • Responsável por trabalhar com a equipe de P&D da China para estabelecer o procedimento de homologação e conduzir os testes de produtos e componentes;
  • Coordenar e gerenciar os processos de homologação de veículos e equipamentos pesados junto aos órgãos reguladores brasileiros (Detran, INMETRO, IBAMA etc.);
  • Atuar na certificação de produtos em conformidade com normas como CAT (Certificado de Adequação Técnica), ISO 9001, IATF 16949 e demais regulamentações aplicáveis;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias para otimizar os processos de homologação, reduzindo prazos e custos;
  • Atuar como elo técnico com entidades certificadoras, laboratórios de testes e órgãos reguladores para assegurar a conformidade dos produtos;
  • Liderar auditorias internas e externas, supervisionando inspeções e certificações necessárias;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia, qualidade e produção para aprimorar processos e garantir conformidade técnica;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre mudanças na legislação e nas normas técnicas do setor automotivo e de máquinas pesadas.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em homologação de veículos, máquinas pesadas ou equipamentos industriais;
  • Conhecimento avançado das regulamentações do setor automotivo e de equipamentos da linha amarela;
  • Expertise em processos de certificação CAT;
  • Experiência de trabalho com órgãos reguladores brasileiros (Detran, ANTT, IBAMA, INMETRO etc.);
  • Perfil estratégico, capacidade de liderança e experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Fluência em português e inglês (mandarim será considerado um diferencial).

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Cloud Engineer - Cloud Solutions Specialist (LATAM)

Position Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer / Cloud Solutions Specialist with a strong technical background in cloud and DevOps practices, focused on the Latin American (LATAM) market. This role bridges technical expertise with client engagement—guiding customers to understand how Matilda Cloud’s offerings solve their challenges.

The ideal candidate will be fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, highly skilled in customer engagement, and comfortable translating complex technology into clear business value.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Communicate fluently in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, serving as the primary technical point of contact for LATAM clients.
  • Work alongside the sales team to gather customer requirements and devise effective technical strategies that address the specific needs of the LATAM market.
  • Partner with client IT and business teams to troubleshoot issues, remove roadblocks, and accelerate solution deployment .
  • Engage with partners to provide comprehensive training and enablement on Matilda Cloud solutions.
  • Collect customer feedback and relay insights to product and engineering teams to continuously improve offerings.
  • Support developers in containerizing applications and migrating them to Kubernetes.
  • Automate recurring tasks in container-based workflows into reusable CI/CD assets.
  • Design, build, manage and operate the infrastructure and configuration of container platforms with a focus on automation and infrastructure-as-cod
  • Manage Hybrid cloud enterprise Kubernetes clusters
  • Ensure reliable WFH readiness with stable high-bandwidth internet.
  • Travel across LATAM as needed for meetings and events.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s/master’s in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud, DevOps, or technical sales engineering in LATAM.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux platforms .
  • Hands-on with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud).
  • Expertise in Kubernetes, container platforms, and hybrid cloud operations .
  • Proficiency in automation tools (Ansible, Helm, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Strong scripting background (Bash, Korn shell, PowerShell).
  • Exceptional communication and client-facing experience .
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-changing environment.
  • Availability for regional travel.

Why Join Matilda Cloud?

Matilda Cloud offers a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits, and a vibrant, supportive work culture. We are dedicated to innovation and quality, providing our team with opportunities for professional growth and meaningful contributions to the cloud computing field.

Apply Now: 

If you are passionate about leveraging your cloud technology expertise to drive engagements within the LATAM market and are fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, we invite you to apply. Join Matilda Cloud to be at the forefront of delivering transformative cloud solutions across LATAM.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.

  • Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil

KEY Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, including code quality, testing, and documentation.

Responsibilities And Authorities

  • Authority to make technical decisions related to software architecture and design.
  • Access to all necessary information and tools to perform role effectively.
  • Responsibility for delivering high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.
  • Authority to mentor and provide career development support to junior developers.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project assignments and career development.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers

  • Internal: Work closely with other software developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.
  • External: Interact with external stakeholders during product demos or user feedback sessions.

Skills

Key competencies, Relevant Knowledge, skills and competEncies

  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Familiarity with Git versioning systems.

Languages

  • Proficiency in English for listening, reading and writing. Intermediate speaking skills in English. Proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese.

Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Java/Kotlin.
  • Deep knowledge of Spring MVC and/or Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in interacting with relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of distributed architectures and messaging systems (RabbitMQ, AMQP, etc).
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes, etc).

Experience

  • Software Engineer, Backend Engineer or similar position.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience.

Personal qualities

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead projects.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.

Expected outcome and deliverables -(For the role, on a 3-5 years horizon)

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.

Vingcard Athos Team

title: Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?

Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.

Como Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence , sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.

O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.

Responsabilidades:

  • Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
  • Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.

Requisitos e Perfil:

  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
  • Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/LookML, publicação);
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Interesse por cybersecurity.

Diferenciais:

  • Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
  • Projetos com LLMs, LangChain, RAG ou chatbots;
  • Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.
  • Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.

Sobre a UPX:

Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact ! Quais serão suas atividades; Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar : transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.  
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior especializado(a) em Google Cloud Platform para projetar, implementar e otimizar pipelines de dados escaláveis e robustos. Você será responsável por arquitetar soluções que suportem grandes volumes de dados, garantindo segurança, qualidade e disponibilidade das informações para análise e tomada de decisão.

A Engenharia de Dados é responsável por desenvolver, implementar e manter o Pipeline de Dados. Este Pipeline contempla todas as etapas relacionadas ao fluxo de dados, desde a extração, passando pelo armazenamento, até a distribuição dos dados para consumo. O que inclui a capacidade de:

• implantar,

• monitorar,

• manter e

• proteger

Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de dados na GCP utilizando serviços como BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer, entre outros.

Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines ETL/ELT escaláveis e de alta performance.

Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados de ponta a ponta.

Criar e manter modelos de dados alinhados com as necessidades de negócio.

Atuar em conjunto com cientistas de dados, analistas e engenheiros de software para suportar casos de uso de análise avançada e machine learning.

Automatizar processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados.

Monitorar e otimizar custo e desempenho dos recursos na GCP.

Implementar boas práticas de DataOps e Governança de Dados.

Experiência de 5 anos, sendo pelo menos 2 com GCP.

Conhecimento das camadas do datalake.

Domínio de BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Storage e Pub/Sub.

Experiência com Python, SQL e preferencialmente Java/Scala.

Conhecimento de orquestração com Cloud Composer (Airflow).

Experiência com modelagem de dados (relacional, dimensional e NoSQL).

Conhecimento em processamento batch e streaming.

Experiência com otimização de custo e performance na nuvem.

Vivência com CI/CD aplicado a pipelines de dados (Git, Cloud Build, Terraform).

Certificações GCP (ex.: Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect).

Conhecimento em Kubernetes (GKE) e APIs na GCP.

Experiência com BigQuery, Dataflow, Vertex AI, SaaS, APIGee (foco em GCP).

Experiência em Machine Learning pipelines (Vertex AI, AI Platform).

Atuação prévia com Data Mesh e arquiteturas distribuídas.

Soft Skills :

Perfil colaborativo e capacidade de trabalho em equipes multidisciplinares.

Boa comunicação técnica e não técnica.

Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas.

Habilidade de mentoria para engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.

title: Pessoa desenvolvedora de iOS Pleno
description:
A WeFit é uma empresa de Design de Serviços Digitais com o propósito de transformar estratégias, objetivos e necessidades em experiências por meio de Design, Processos e Tecnologia.

Nossa filosofia central é a resolução de problemas. Valorizamos a criatividade e inovação, o nosso foco principal está em encontrar soluções práticas e eficazes para os desafios de entregar uma boa experiência para os usuários e agregar valor para os negócios dos nossos clientes.

Procuramos profissionais que compartilhem dessa visão e que estejam prontos para buscar profundidade em situações complexas com uma mentalidade voltada para a resolução de problemas.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

Como desenvolvedor frontend na WeFit, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em aplicativos Web e Mobile, participando do desenvolvimento desde os estágios iniciais, com a definição da arquitetura, até a evolução e manutenção da aplicação. Nesse sentido será exigido o conhecimento de bons padrões para que os sistemas evoluam de forma saudável. Além disso, você terá o importante papel de colaborar com o designer na exploração dos casos de uso com o objetivo de entregar uma experiência robusta. Por fim, você também poderá contribuir introduzindo novos processos, tecnologias e arquiteturas em um ambiente com ampla abertura para discussões.

Em relação ao modelo de trabalho, gostamos de nos encontrar e por isso adotamos o trabalho híbrido (frequência será combinada), mas se você é de outro estado, também temos espaço para você trabalhar 100% remoto.

Requisitos

- Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações Mobile na plataforma iOS;

- Conhecimento de Swift e Objective-C;

- Conhecimento da Arquitetura MVVM;

- Conhecimento da configuração do CocoaPods;

- Experiência na integração com APIs;

- Experiência com testes unitários ou E2E;

- Ferramentas e processos de versionamento com Git;

- Preocupação constante com arquitetura e documentação;

- Conforto em trabalhar em um ambiente altamente colaborativo.

- Experiência com tecnologias para CI e CD.

Diferenciais

- Experiência com frameworks de segurança (KeyChainAccess);

- Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações Mobile com React Native;

title: Sales Consultant
description:
About Us

Established 20 years ago, Phi Partners is a global technology services consultancy based out of London with an annualized turnover of £50m.

We operate exclusively within capital markets, in the front office, pricing and risk space, covering both business and technology services. With six lines of business, four international hubs and five international delivery centres, Phi has become a leading global financial markets IT services provider within our niche domains. We have over 500 consultants supporting more than 80 financial institutions around the world.

Our international sales team run out of Wrotham Business Park in London where we have over 30 sales consultants covering the broad range of business lines, clients and geographies. This team includes junior sales personnel who focus primarily on candidate research and recruitment whilst they are being trained to become client-facing sales consultants and eventually account managers. We are now expanding out Sales & Research team to include a team in our São Paulo office!

Phi offers our clients a comprehensive range of services including staff augmentation, advisory, project and managed services. These deals range from £100,000 to £20,000,000 in size, creating huge revenue and earnings opportunities.

Role and Career Opportunities

Phi has an ongoing commitment to growth in terms of client acquisition, geographical reach, and evolution of our lines of business and service catalogue. To support our ambitions, we take on four cohorts of junior sales consultants each year, in January, April, July, and October. Each consultant is trained the “Phi way”.

We are looking for talent who are either fresh out of university or in the early stages of their careers. Subject to meeting reasonable competency and performance targets, you can expect regular opportunities for advancement throughout your journey:

  • In the first 6 months you will be in our London Office being trained by our leadership team.
  • Initially, you will focus on candidate research and recruitment. After six months, you will be allocated to a line of business, allowing you to become a specialist recruiter within that field. Training that is specific to the line of business will allow you to master your ability to converse confidently with client and internal specialists.
  • After a period of between 12-18 months, you can expect to begin your move into client-facing sales. You will be allocated a small number of clients specific to your line of business, beginning your journey with client research, leading into full client engagement if the client is approved as a target.
  • Once you have closed deals with clients (bringing master services agreements between the client and Phi), you will begin to generate P&L. Subject to competency and revenue targets, you will complete your move into sales. We expect this phase to take between 18-24 months, and you will be supported on your journey by more senior sales leads, a deal architecture / pre-sales team, and the subject-matter-experts from within the delivery teams.
  • As a fully-fledged sales consultant, you will be part of a smaller group of 10, that are some of the best in the world. You will manage your client portfolio and may be given an expanded scope of clients giving you the room to really become a true success. Depending on results, you may be allocated one or two strategic key accounts, with the greatest potential for growth. These accounts are global, and relevant for multiple lines of business. They will bring a large portfolio, driving significant P&L and earnings.

Our most successful salespeople will make Partner at Phi, giving access to stock in the company that is granted annually based on a transparent assessment of contribution. Within the sales team we have three partners today, all of whom came through the graduate program, and we except two more to get promoted in 2025. The sky is the limit at Phi for the most ambitions and driven!

What we are looking for

Commitment and drive

We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to succeed, and who are prepared to do “whatever it takes”. We are looking for problem solvers who have the ability to “find a way” to solve any challenge; people who won’t give up when the going gets tough! To become successful, it will take a long time to develop the required skills to be independent and to operate autonomously. So, we are looking for people who are truly committed and driven. These are all skills that you will have had life-long, applied and improved over many years. We will be looking to understand what drives you at a fundamental level, as this is what you will rely on to succeed.

Communication and charisma

Our sales consultants must be great communicators: people who have natural confidence with person-to-person communication, from over-the-phone interactions to directing meetings with senior stakeholders. You will need to be charismatic and confident. An ability to develop meaningful and relationships built on respect and trust is critical.

Team spirit

At Phi we have maintained a “small company” mindset and feel, with an excellent team spirit – we work together, we socialize together, we support each other. Our appreciation for the wider Phi community makes us stronger than the sum of our parts. We are looking for people who will naturally be at home as part of a strong team – who can understand our values, contribute to the wider Phi community, share knowledge, and put the team before themselves. We will be looking for evidence of this, academically, professionally, or outside (such as sport).

Life at Phi

Phi is an established business but feels like a start-up, specially being part of our brand-new team in Brazil. Your base will be in São Paulo, but as you develop into client-facing sales, you will spend time out of the office and will have opportunities for regular international travel.

Our family mentality means that even the most junior at Phi has access to the senior leadership team. We are approachable. You will be on first name terms with the CRO and CEO. Beyond the sales team, you will work within a wider community across pre-sales and delivery, specific to your clients and your line-of-business.

Our company thrives in having a diverse and international staff and this is especially true in our London office, where the Sales & Research team is located. Our sales consultants come from all parts of the world and there is a vibrant and youthful atmosphere. The atmosphere is dynamic and busy (punctual starts and hard work are inevitable), but always friendly. We socialize regularly outside office hours. Many of the senior team members at Phi have known each other for decades, and people who are the right fit for Phi can expect to build friendships that will last a lifetime. The goal is to build a similar environment in our new operation in Brazil!

Training and Reward

You can expect initial and ongoing training, in a well-designed, competency-based framework with a comprehensive and growing learning and development library. You can expect to be carefully performance-managed using our proprietary tools, ensuring that your contributions are fairly measured and that you are supported in your drive to succeed in any areas that need developing.

We offer competitive salaries and the best commission structure in the market. We have a simple and straightforward commission model that rewards you for what you generate. With no caps, your earning potential is unlimited.

title: Public Relations Manager - LATAM
description:
About Cooler Master

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.

In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.

Role Overview

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.
  • Build Media Relationships – Cultivate strong connections with top-tier tech and gaming editors, reviewers, and influencers across Portuguese and Spanish-speaking markets.

  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.

Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise :
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement :
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.

Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Gerente de Vendas | Microgrid
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.

Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto.

Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m². Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa. E

m 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril. No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Ser responsável pelo desenvolvimento de mercado e pela implementação da estratégia de marketing para o negócio de microgrids no Brasil;
  • Coordenar os recursos locais, promover a implementação de projetos e ser responsável pelo acompanhamento da operação e gestão;
  • Colaborar com departamentos internos e externos para avaliar e determinar a viabilidade de soluções técnicas;
  • Reportar regularmente sobre o progresso dos negócios regionais, analisar a dinâmica do mercado e propor recomendações estratégicas de otimização.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência anterior com vendas no setor de microgrids;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Excelentes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação intercultural, com capacidade de adaptação a ambientes de trabalho diversos.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

Sobre a ZEISS:

- Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

- Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica :

- Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.

Sobre nossa posição de Técnico / Engenheiro de Campo:

Base de Trabalho - Belém e Região.

Atividades:

- Instalação, calibração, manutenção (preventiva e corretiva) de equipamentos médicos.

- Manter registros dos serviços executados e enviar relatórios dos atendimentos realizados.

- Garantir a satisfação do cliente de acordo com métricas de atendimento, prazo, performance e qualidade.

Requisitos:

- Experiência anterior com instalação e manutenção de equipamentos médicos.

- Conhecimentos em TI (Hardware / Software / Redes - instalação / formatação / configuração).

- Graduação em Engenharia e/ou formação técnica (Eletrotécnica, Eletromecânica, Mecatrônica, Eletrônica, Elétrica).

- CNH em dia e disponibilidade para viagens.

- Bom nível de Inglês é imprescindível.

Nosso compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão:

A ZEISS promove a igualdade de oportunidades. Independente de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, idade, crença ou deficiência, todas as pessoas qualificadas são bem-vindas em nossos processos seletivos. Valorizamos a diversidade, respeitamos as diferenças e trabalhamos continuamente para construir um ambiente mais justo, inclusivo e com equidade.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;

Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;

Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.

Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
  • Expand Judi, our web-based enterprise health platform, using Python, AWS services, React/Typescript, and other technologies.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Preferred Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.

What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work.

This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

Atuará de forma transversal, conectando-se com clientes internos, auditoria, análise de custos e estratégia de suprimentos, com foco em excelência operacional, sustentabilidade da cadeia e alinhamento às metas organizacionais.

  • Conduzir análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO) e estudos comparativos de fornecedores.

  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e recomendações para a liderança, baseados em dados e benchmarks.

  • Atuar como ponto focal entre fornecedores, áreas operacionais e stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.

  • Promover boas práticas de Procura e Compliance junto ao time e stakeholders.
  • Participar ativamente de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, propondo inovações em processos, ferramentas e estratégias de compras.
  • Apoiar treinamentos internos e o desenvolvimento de capacidades em Procurement e Strategic Sourcing.

  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Logística ou áreas correlatas.

  • Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.
  • Vivência em empresas globais e ambientes multiculturais.
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre gestão de estoques.

Competências & Habilidades:

  • Habilidade de negociação e influência em diferentes níveis.

  • Comunicação clara, assertiva e foco em relacionamento colaborativo.

description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works.

About Our Search

We are currently looking for a Casting Coordinator to join our client, a global content company with a focus on talent sourcing for dynamic content projects.

  • 2+ years of experience in casting, story production, or talent interviewing.
